svg.title: Pumpkin wallet: how back-loop ribbing makes pumpkin ribs
svg.desc: The hook goes through the back loop. The front loop is left as a ridge. One rib shows for every two turned rows.

g.text: Each single crochet has a front loop
Work into the back loop only. The
front loop stays as a ridge.
You turn every row, so the ridges
land on one face every other row.
22 rows in the back loop make 11
Working both loops makes a flat face
Two oranges can change every 2 rows
so each rib is one shade.
Measure the width to 4.25 in either
way. Do not trust the row count
